name: dsh-theme-endfield-contour-rework
description: Fork of dsh-theme-endfield (Arknights: Endfield industrial editorial theme for DeepSeek Harness) with a redesigned contour animation engine: precomputed tileable Perlin terrain, marching-squares contours, cached-texture scrolling. AI-assisted fork; only tested on DSH 0.1.1-rc.2.
